D: In a retro-futuristic 1960s New York, the Fantastic Four face Galactus while Sue and Reed await their first child.
P: Serve the mains when the family sits down together at the Baxter Building.
S: Sixties devilled eggs and cheese hedgehog
Paprika devilled eggs, plus cheddar and pineapple cubes on toothpicks

Devilled eggs with paprika, and cheese and pineapple on toothpicks stuck into a halved grapefruit, a proper sixties party spread. Boil 8 eggs for 10 minutes, halve and mash the yolks with mayonnaise, then pipe back and dust with paprika. Cube 200g cheddar and pineapple and thread onto toothpicks. Stick them into a halved grapefruit set cut side down, a proper sixties spread.

Cooked prawns on shredded iceberg in little glasses, under a pink cocktail sauce with a dusting of paprika and a lemon wedge. Peel 600g cooked prawns, keeping 8 whole for the tops, and chop the rest roughly. Mix 120g mayo, 2 tbsp tomato sauce, 1 tsp Worcestershire sauce, a squeeze of lemon and a dash of Tabasco. Shred half an iceberg lettuce finely and divide between 8 small glasses. Spoon in the chopped prawns and the sauce, top each with a whole prawn, a dusting of paprika and a lemon wedge.
Baby potatoes roasted in foil with butter, garlic and rosemary
Baby potatoes wrapped in foil with butter, garlic and rosemary, roasted at 200C for 40 minutes, opened at the table with sour cream.
M: Retro roast chicken with glazed carrots
Butter, lemon and thyme roast chicken, glazed carrots, mashed potatoes

Chicken roasted at 200C with lemon and thyme, with glazed carrots, mashed potato and peas, served on a big platter like a sixties ad. Rub a whole chicken with butter, lemon and thyme and roast at 200C for 75 minutes. Glaze sliced carrots in butter and a little sugar. Mash 1kg potatoes with butter and cook peas. Serve everything on one big platter like a sixties advertisement.

Beef meatloaf with onion and breadcrumbs under a sticky tomato and brown sugar glaze, sliced thick with buttered green beans and mash. Mix 800g beef mince, 1 grated onion, 60g breadcrumbs, 2 eggs, 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce and salt, then press into a loaf tin. Mix 100ml tomato sauce, 2 tbsp brown sugar and 1 tsp mustard and spread on top. Bake at 180C for 1 hour and rest 10 minutes. Boil 1kg potatoes and mash with butter and milk. Blanch 300g green beans for 3 minutes and toss with butter.
W: Strawberry jelly set in a ring with strawberries and green grapes
A big ring of strawberry jelly set with sliced strawberries and grapes, turned out onto a plate with whipped cream.
K: Orange juice blended with vanilla ice cream and milk, whipped cream on top
Orange juice blended with vanilla ice cream and milk, topped with cream, retro diner style.

dishes.n: Sixties devilled eggs and cheese hedgehog

steps.text: Boil the eggs, cool, peel and halve.
Mash the yolks with mayonnaise, pipe back into the whites and dust with paprika.
Thread cheddar and pineapple onto toothpicks and stick them into the grapefruit, cut side down.
Divide the potatoes among squares of foil and add butter, garlic, rosemary and salt to each.
Wrap tightly into parcels and roast at 200C.
Open at the table and add a spoon of sour cream.

dishes.n: Retro roast chicken with glazed carrots

steps.text: Rub the chicken with butter, lemon and thyme.
Roast at 200C until golden and cooked through.
Glaze the carrots in butter and a little sugar.
Boil and mash the potatoes with butter and cook the peas.
Serve everything on one big platter like a sixties advertisement.
Make up the jelly with a little less water than the packet says.
Pour a layer into a ring mould with sliced strawberries and grapes.
Chill until set, then fill with the rest.
Turn out and serve with whipped cream.
Blend the orange juice, ice cream, milk and vanilla until thick and creamy.
Pour into tall glasses and top with whipped cream and an orange slice.

s.n: Sixties devilled eggs and cheese hedgehog
s.note: Paprika devilled eggs, plus cheddar and pineapple cubes on toothpicks
s.how: Boil 8 eggs for 10 minutes, halve and mash the yolks with mayonnaise, then pipe back and dust with paprika. Cube 200g cheddar and pineapple and thread onto toothpicks. Stick them into a halved grapefruit set cut side down, a proper sixties spread.

s.note: Baby potatoes roasted in foil with butter, garlic and rosemary
s.how: Halve 800g baby potatoes and divide among 4 squares of foil. Add butter, crushed garlic, rosemary and salt to each and wrap tightly into silver parcels. Roast at 200C for 40 minutes. Open at the table and add a spoon of sour cream.

m.n: Retro roast chicken with glazed carrots
m.note: Butter, lemon and thyme roast chicken, glazed carrots, mashed potatoes
m.how: Rub a whole chicken with butter, lemon and thyme and roast at 200C for 75 minutes. Glaze sliced carrots in butter and a little sugar. Mash 1kg potatoes with butter and cook peas. Serve everything on one big platter like a sixties advertisement.

w.note: Strawberry jelly set in a ring with strawberries and green grapes
w.how: Make up 3 packets of strawberry jelly with a little less water than the packet says. Pour a layer into a ring mould with sliced strawberries and green grapes, chill until set, then fill with the rest. Chill overnight, turn out and serve with whipped cream.

d.note: Orange juice blended with vanilla ice cream and milk, whipped cream on top
d.how: Blend 400ml orange juice with 4 scoops vanilla ice cream, 200ml milk and 1 tsp vanilla until thick and creamy. Pour into 4 tall glasses and top with a little whipped cream and an orange slice.
